newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian manager to join Pilkington - report.
newsitem.headline: Italian manager to join Pilkington - report.

text.p: Paolo Scaroni, executive vice chairman at Italian engineering group Techint, is expected to take up an appointment with British glassmaker Pilkington, an Italian newspaper reported on Thursday.
Milan daily Corriere della Sera, quoting market sources, said Scaroni could move to London in the near future to join Pilkington's top management.
Techint and Pilkington jointly acquired Italian glass maker Siv from defunct state industrial holding company Efim in 1993. Pilkington bought out Techint's share in Siv last year.
Scaroni worked for French group Saint Gobain before joining Techint in 1985.
